comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Two more dialogs read the same way, 2026-10-05 (0.13.0): in fresh panes, Claude Code's workspace-trust prompt ("Accessing workspace: /home ... ❯ No, exit / Yes, I trust this folder") and Codex 0.159's startup hook review ("Hooks need review / 27 hooks are new or changed / › 1. Review hooks / 2. Trust all and continue / 3. Continue without trusting") both showed `idle` in `muster window` and ended `muster pane wait --until idle,blocked` as idle. An orchestrator that posts as soon as a spawned agent is idle would ring into either: for the trust prompt, a ring's Return answers "No, exit".

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-10-03 driving three Claude Code workers: a session sitting at its ExitPlanMode dialog ("Claude has written up a plan and is ready to execute. Would you like to proceed?" with numbered options) showed `done` in `muster window`, while the same screen is plainly waiting on a person. `muster pane wait --until blocked` therefore never fires for it, and the agent list paints it as finished rather than asking.

Find which source decided it: the hooks adapter (extras/claude-code - a Stop or Notification event mapped to done?) or the screen rules (crates/muster-detect/manifests/claude.toml has no rule for this dialog?). Record the screen into the detection corpus and pin it blocked. A permission prompt reads blocked today; this dialog should too.
title: 🚦 A Claude Code plan-approval dialog reads as done, not blocked
